transliteration: satyapraśaṃsāvacanair anṛtasyāpavarjanaiḥ / sabhyaiḥ saṃbodhanīyās tu dharmaśāstrārthavedibhiḥ // BrhS_1,5.32
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who know the meaning of Dharma Śāstra shall be honored with truthful praise and kept free from falsehood.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with Satya (Truth)
Capacity-based responsibility requires integrity in speech
Restoration occurs through elevation of consciousness via truth-speaking
Consciousness alignment is prerequisite for jurisprudential legitimacy
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity knows Dharma Śāstra THEN that entity MUST receive affirmation through satyapraśaṃsā (truthful praise)
IF entity engages in anṛta (falsehood) THEN that entity MUST NOT be consulted in judicial or advisory capacity
IF entity demonstrates sabhya status AND vedavid THEN that entity SHALL BE prioritized in dharma-advisory roles
NO judicial process shall proceed without invocation of satyapraśaṃsā toward qualified sabhyas
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court proceedings, only those learned in Dharma Śāstra and demonstrated by their conduct to uphold Satya shall be permitted to offer counsel or testimony. All others must undergo purification protocols before participation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that error arises from misalignment with Satya. Therefore, correction lies in reorientation through pramāṇa-reinforcing discourse, not punitive exclusion. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms that integrity precedes authority; hence restoration flows naturally when Satya is reinstated.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Conduct a Praśaṃsā Yajña where community publicly affirms the sabhya's adherence to Satya
Implement Apavarga Vākya practice: structured verbal environment excluding all forms of anṛta during deliberations
Initiate Śabdātma Samāropa: immersion in scriptural recitation until vibrational harmony with Satya is restored
Establish Svādhyāya Mandalas for continuous self-realignment through scriptural study
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma is restored through Satya-vāk alignment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
